description: Central sector scheme providing income support to landholding farmer families across the country.
benefit: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year, transferred directly into bank accounts in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each.

description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
benefit: Full financial risk coverage against natural crop loss, with nominal premium of 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.

description: Government subsidy scheme promoting modern farm machinery and equipment adoption among small and marginal farmers.
benefit: 40% to 50% financial subsidy on the purchase of agricultural machinery, tractors, and power tillers.
